Irving explains why he believes SEAL Team Six carried out the historic raid and why he accepts O’Neill’s account despite public disputes from others in the special operations community. The conversation touches on Matt Bissonnette, Admiral Bill McRaven, President Barack Obama, Fort Campbell, the 160th SOAR, Army Rangers, and the controversy over who fired the fatal shots.

Irving and O’Neill also reflect on the bigger picture: brotherhood, combat, confirmed kills, veteran mental health, suicide prevention, and alternative healing through psychedelics, DMT, and sobriety. A candid look at bin Laden’s death, military legacy, and why both men say veterans should focus less on infighting and more on helping each other.

Jack Burkman and Jacob Wohl of Washington, DC lobbying firm J.M. Burkman and Associates sit down with VladTV to answer Boosie Badazz’s claims that he paid $600,000 for help pursuing a Donald Trump pardon and was scammed. The pair deny wrongdoing, saying they were paid for advocacy—not a guaranteed pardon—and argue Boosie’s federal gun case, sentencing timeline, alleged new legal issues, and later arbitration filing complicated the effort.

They also respond to the 60 Minutes report, disputed text messages naming Laura Loomer, Mike Johnson, Erica Kirk and others, and comparisons to Bradford Cohen’s successful pardon work for Lil Wayne and Kodak Black. The conversation expands into Trump’s pardon process, DOJ pardon counsel, Joseph Schwartz’s commutation, lobbying ethics, and their past controversies involving robocalls, voter suppression cases in Michigan and New York, FCC fines, Politico’s LobbyMatic reporting, and Jacob Wohl’s securities case.
